campaign: 8X v3 in the Gen 8 arena · Gen 8 through trick 6, rollouts blended in from trick 7 in games, claims, mixing
interpretation: 8X v3 against Gen 8 in common auctions is card play alone, and 8X v3 equals Gen 8 through trick 6 and in undoubled partscores. Before the arena, against the same search (8p-32-v41) on 459 boards: +0.02 +- 0.13 IMPs a board. Report common and native conditions separately. Only unplayed source deals are allocated. Intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for repeated monitoring.
model_note: 8X v3 (8x3-32) is the Gen 8 candidate 8s-32 card for card through trick 6, its tree at tricks 3 to 6 included. From trick 7, in games, slams and doubled contracts only, the search's near-best cards are valued again by rollouts on rollout net v1 (policy v4.1 fine-tuned on the Gen 7+ bots' play), blended at trust 0.25; undoubled partscores stay with the search. Declarer keeps a guaranteed contract (games, slams, doubled), plays a card that guarantees every trick left in any contract, and defenders avoid handing declarer a guaranteed line. Equal cards are mixed in proportion to the net's probability to the power 2 (declaring side) or 3 (defenders). Settings are in the bot's `gen7` and `x8` blocks (bridge_harness/x8_player.py).

difference_definition.unit: IMPs per board, candidate minus opponent
difference_definition.bidding: Native minus common on the same board; includes auction/play interaction
difference_definition.uncertainty: Student-t intervals on paired per-board differences; exploratory, unadjusted for repeated monitoring
